finalText:
The FB event cover headline ("STOPKY / NELŽOU") is bigger now: 136 px instead of 112, about 20% larger. The canvas check passes.

**Extra change to the carousel slides.** The studio was rejecting every edit to this file because of a problem that was already there: the seven slides got their ids from a loop, and the check only accepts ids written out as plain text. I wrote each slide out separately. Their ids and content are unchanged.

**What I checked:** I screenshotted all 21 artboards and looked at the cover and the seven slides. The images come out as small thumbnails, so they confirm things at a glance but not in detail:
- All seven slides render, each with its own discipline name.
- On the cover, the bigger headline still sits above the bottom strip and nothing overlaps.

I couldn't measure spacing or the safe zone at full size, so give the cover a quick look in the studio.

I didn't touch variants B and C or the other artboards. If you want those headlines bigger too, say so.
